explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/997: is {α p_n} not well-distributed for every α? The docstring cites a solution in APSSV26 §4 with a Lean formalisation. IsWellDistributed matches the page's definition: for every ε > 0 and large k, for all n and all intervals [a,b) ⊆ [0,1], the count in (n, n+k] is within εk of (b-a)k. Allowing n = 0 and half-open intervals are immaterial conventions. The statement asserts non-well-distribution for every real α, which is trivial for rational α. Faithful.
